title.message: The first line must be the title, starting with "# ".

fields.name: what the template is called, like "user story"
fields.patterns: a list of patterns; each must match a line of "The story"

sections.heading: ## Acceptance criteria
sections.name: Acceptance criteria
sections.itemMessage: Each acceptance criterion must read "Given ..., when ..., then ...".

sections.heading: ## Known
sections.name: Known
sections.itemMessage: This Known item doesn't say where it came from. Add the source in parentheses at the end, or move it to Assumed or Unknown.

lines.message: The first line of Confidence must be exactly High, Medium or Low.
Confidence needs a "Why:" line saying what the rating is based on.
Confidence needs a "How to raise it:" line saying what would make it higher.
The first line of Estimate must read "N to M hours", for example "4 to 8 hours".
lines.ascendingMessage: The estimate says {low} to {high} hours. The first number can't be bigger than the second.

lines.message: Estimate needs a "Basis:" line saying what the hours are based on.

questionMarks.message: Each item in {name} must ask one question, with exactly one question mark. This one has {count}.

overflow.line: More open questions than fit here. Consider a spike first.
overflow.message: The line "More open questions than fit here. Consider a spike first." must come last, after five questions.
overflow.confidenceMessage: Confidence can't be High while there are more open questions than fit. Lower it, or answer some questions first.

messages.extraTitle: Only the first line can be a title. Start section headings with "## ".
messages.strayText: This text sits above the first section. Only the title goes there.
messages.unknownSection: "{heading}" is not an allowed section. The sections are: {order}.
messages.outOfOrder: "{heading}" is out of order. The sections must be: {order}.
messages.emptyNoneAllowed: {name} is empty. List the items, or write "None."
messages.noneNotAllowed: {name} can't be "None." It needs at least one item.
messages.noneMixed: {name} says "None." but also lists items. Use one or the other.
messages.notAListItem: {name} must be a list, one item per line, each starting with "- ".
messages.extraLine: {name} has an extra line. It should have exactly {count} lines.
messages.noTemplate: The story section doesn't follow any template. Tried: {names}. For a team template, put it in a templates folder next to the team's context folder, or pass --templates <folder>.
messages.templateMissingField: The template's front matter is missing "{field}": {help}.
